cues.en: Latest from the Missouri's fake news factory is from the Saint Louis Post Dispatch where a reporter has been digging around HTML code on a state website.
cues.zh: 密苏里州假新闻工厂的最新消息，来自《圣路易斯邮报》：一名记者一直在州政府网站上翻查 HTML 代码。

cues.en: The state technology division said the hacker took the records of at least three educators,
cues.zh: 州技术部门表示，黑客获取了至少三名教育工作者的记录，

cues.en: decoded the HTML source code, and viewed the social security numbers of teachers from a state website.
cues.zh: 解码了 HTML 源代码，并查看了州政府网站上教师的社会安全号码。

cues.en: Governor Parson believes everyone is entitled to their privacy, especially our teachers. Governor Parson is standing up to the fake news media and is committed to bring to justice anyone who obtained private information. The Saint Louis Post Dispatch is purely playing politics.
cues.zh: 帕森州长认为，每个人都有权保护隐私，尤其是我们的教师。帕森州长正在反击假新闻媒体，并决心将任何获取私人信息的人绳之以法。《圣路易斯邮报》纯粹是在玩政治。

cues.en: Exploiting private information is a squalid excuse for journalism,
cues.zh: 利用私人信息来冒充新闻报道是极其卑劣的借口，

cues.en: and hiding behind the noble principle of free speech to do it is shameful.
cues.zh: 而躲在言论自由这一崇高原则背后这么做，更是可耻。
